gaps.sentence: I can't make ___ what the sign says from here.
gaps.explanation: make out = see, hear or understand with difficulty.

gaps.sentence: You should cut down ___ sugar if you want to lose weight.
gaps.explanation: cut down ON something = reduce it; cut out = eliminate completely.

gaps.sentence: We had to call ___ the order because the kitchen had closed.
We need to iron ___ a few details before signing.
Hold ___ a moment — I'll check if he's in.
gaps.explanation: hold on = wait (especially on the phone).

gaps.sentence: Her essay stands ___ from the rest of the class.
gaps.explanation: stand out = be easy to notice, be better/different.

gaps.sentence: Do you get ___ well with your new colleagues?
gaps.explanation: get on (with) = have a good relationship; also get along with (AmE).
